Package Amphipolis.Javadoc

package Amphipolis.Javadoc
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Controller
    The Controller class acts as the intermediary between the Model (logic) and the View (GUI).
    Model
    The Model class represents the core logic, state, and data of the "Amphipolis" board game.
    Model.ButtonTiles
    Represents a tile specifically located on the game board.
    Model.CardTiles
    Represents a special Character Card with unique game abilities.
    Model.InventoryTiles
    Represents a basic tile item in a player's inventory.
    Model.TilesBag
    Manages the "bag" of tiles from which players draw.
    View
    The View class extends JFrame and manages the Graphical User Interface (GUI) of the application.
    View.ButtonTilesView
    Concrete implementation of LabelWithImageAndText for tiles on the Game Board.
    View.CardTilesView
    Concrete implementation for Character Cards.
    View.GameLabels
    Wrapper class for JLabel to manage game images and text labels easily.
    View.InventoryTilesView
    Concrete implementation of LabelWithImageAndText for items in the Player's inventory.
    View.LabelWithImageAndText
    Abstract base class for all tile-based views (Inventory, Board, Cards).
    View.MenuButtons
    Wrapper class for JButton to manage menu and control buttons.
